[[Jet Propulsion]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Jet Propulsion]]:''' Use this item to activate the air elemental bound within, thus propelling you forward at great speeds. It takes ten minutes to recharge between uses.
''1 use per 10 minutes (equivalent to [[Abundant Step]]/[[Leap of Faith]]/[[Air Savant enhancements#Wind_Dance|Wind Dance]])''
